head: codex/252-guardian-hosted-spawn-flake
title: [v0.92][Runtime v3] Eliminate hosted Guardian executable spawn flake
body:
Closes #252

## Summary
- serialize process-heavy Guardian invocations only in test builds
- prevent the directly included parity target from converting hosted lease, pipe, or child resource pressure into unrelated `SpawnFailed` outcomes
- preserve production Guardian concurrency and genuine missing-program fail-closed semantics

## Validation
- Guardian namespace: 10 repeated passes with 8 requested test threads across repository-root and crate caller working directories
- parity_b_live_kernel: 27/27 passed
- complete adl-runtime-kernel test boundary: passed
- strict all-target Clippy with `-D warnings`: passed
- fresh exact-head rereview: PASS with no actionable findings

## Integration
This is the bounded prerequisite repair for the required Runtime CI failure blocking PR #243. Hosted Linux remains CI proof after publication.

## Non-goals
No birth-witness behavior change, optional or paid CI, Guardian redesign, or merge authority.
